The card draws View bars today, no line primitive and no chart package: bars are replaced by dots (percent positioning by calendar day) and a line made of rotated 2px View segments sized from onLayout. Helpers ewmaTrend, visibleTrend, weightRatePerWeek (window = last 14 days counted back from today, x = calendar days, slope x 7), formatWeightRate (U+2212 minus, 0.0 without sign, dash), weightChange for the Weight tile (the card itself has no change figure).
